long_biography.plain_text:
Neil Keith Nimmo built his career around complex corporate insurance. After senior roles at a specialist London brokerage and Sedgwick, he became a managing director at Marsh before joining Lockton. There he led professional and financial risks and specialty operations, then became managing partner and chief executive of the international business.

As Lockton expanded beyond its home market, Nimmo championed organic growth, specialist recruitment and closer international coordination. He became chairman of Lockton International in 2022, supporting regional businesses across Europe, Asia, Australia, Latin America, the Middle East and Africa. After ending his seventeen-year tenure, he joined Specialist Risk Group in 2025 as its first UK chief executive. The role puts him over the group's retail, wholesale and underwriting pillars, extending a career centred on insurance brokerage, risk management and building specialist teams.
